projects.name: Bina.ai
projects.meta: Mistral LLM × Law Hackathon, Paris, October 2026
projects.context: Hosted by Mistral AI, sponsored by Stanford Law School, Legora, Hector AI, Jus Mundi and Sciences Po.
projects.paragraph: Bina turns French data-protection rulings into briefs for litigation funders. A funder can't act on a brief that misquotes the ruling, so the backend I built checks every quoted sentence, word for word, against the original, and keeps any it can't find out of the pitch.

brief.quote: the company did not implement measures appropriate to the risk
customers were never informed of the breach

quoteCheck.source: … the restricted committee considers that the company did not implement measures appropriate to the risk, within the meaning of Article 32 of the GDPR. The customers concerned were informed by email on …
quoteCheck.idle: Press the button to check both quotes.
quoteCheck.result: First quote found on page 14. Second quote isn't in the source, so it's flagged and kept out of the pitch.
quoteCheck.caption: The quote check, on example text.

projects.name: AIWrappers
projects.paragraph: Someone describes an AI tool in plain words. An agent builds it as a working web app on the customer's own domain, and every app runs on one platform that routes its requests to 38 models from five providers, on the owner's own keys.

fanOut.caption: One agent builds many apps; every request goes through one model router, on the owner's own keys.

caseStudyNotFeatured.name: Caracat at LIP6
caseStudyNotFeatured.summary: With a teammate, compared Caracat, an open-source Rust traceroute-probing engine, with its C++ predecessor Caracal and found matching outputs across ICMP, UDP, IPv4 and IPv6. Part of a four-person team project supervised by Timur Friedman (Dioptra). Graded 86/100, third of twelve.

caseStudyNotFeatured.name: BirdCLEF+ 2026
caseStudyNotFeatured.summary: Classical ML pipeline classifying 206 bird species from 35.5K+ recordings with librosa features; benchmarked five models and reached 0.922 macro ROC-AUC (5-fold CV).
